description: Add CDK assertion tests + Lambda unit tests, and write the README documenting architecture, cost rationale, and deploy/verify instructions (Japanese for user-facing content). Depends on FEAT-002. Tests CANNOT be executed in-sandbox (deps not installed, no network); they are authored to pass once `npm ci` runs in a networked environment. Prefix any node tooling with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS`.
steps: Create Quiz-app/test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts using `import { Template } from 'aws-cdk-lib/assertions'`. Synthesize the stack in-memory (new App, new QuizAppStack, Template.fromStack) and assert: exactly one AWS::DynamoDB::Table with BillingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST; a AWS::Lambda::Function with Architectures ['arm64'] and a Node runtime; an AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api with ProtocolType HTTP; the three routes (AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route) exist (GET /quizzes, GET /quizzes/{quizId}, POST /quizzes/{quizId}/submit); a AWS::CloudFront::Distribution exists with PriceClass PriceClass_100; an S3 bucket with public access blocked. Use Template.resourceCountIs and hasResourceProperties with Match where helpful. NOTE: NodejsFunction bundling with esbuild runs at synth time - if bundling is problematic in a headless test, the test may still synth because esbuild is a local dep; if the coder finds synth requires network/docker, guard by ensuring bundling uses local esbuild (no Docker). Keep assertions resilient (don't assert on generated logical IDs).

Create Quiz-app/test/handler.test.ts unit-testing the Lambda scoring logic. Import the handler (or a pure exported scoring helper - recommend refactoring the score computation into an exported pure function like `scoreAnswers(questions, submittedAnswers)` in lambda/index.ts or a lambda/scoring.ts so it is unit-testable WITHOUT AWS SDK/DynamoDB). Test: correct answers yield full score; partial answers yield partial score; mismatched length / out-of-range answers handled; that returned question payloads omit the answer index. Mock DynamoDB only if testing the handler directly (prefer testing the pure function to avoid SDK mocking).

If needed for testability, refactor lambda/index.ts to export the pure scoring/formatting helpers (this is an allowed small change to FEAT-002 output to enable meaningful tests). Ensure the handler still imports and uses them so tests exercise real production code paths.

Create Quiz-app/README.md (primarily Japanese, code/commands in English) covering: overview of the quiz app; architecture diagram-in-text (CloudFront + S3 static frontend -> API Gateway HTTP API -> Lambda (ARM64) -> DynamoDB on-demand); an explicit COST section explaining why each choice minimizes always-on cost (DynamoDB on-demand = pay-per-request no idle charge; Lambda = pay per invocation, scales to zero; HTTP API cheaper than REST; CloudFront PriceClass_100; S3 pennies; no VPC/NAT/idle EC2/RDS); prerequisites (Node 22, AWS creds, `npx cdk bootstrap`); step-by-step deploy: `npm install`, `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npx cdk synth`, `npx cdk deploy`, then note how to set the frontend API base (window.API_BASE / config.js) to the deployed API endpoint; a clear note that this project was authored in a no-network sandbox so `npm install`/build/synth/deploy were NOT executed here and must be run by the operator; and a teardown note (`npx cdk destroy`). Also mention optional follow-ups: add Cognito for auth, custom domain, CI.

Do NOT run tests or build (no network/deps). Confirm test files reference real exports from the stack and handler. Record in findings that `npm test`/`npx cdk synth` are deferred to a networked environment.
acceptance_criteria: The stack test asserts DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST, Lambda arm64, HTTP API protocol, the three routes, CloudFront PriceClass_100, and S3 public-access-blocked
The handler test exercises the real scoring logic via an exported pure function (not only static/mocked values) and would fail if the scoring code were broken
README.md exists with architecture, an explicit cost-minimization rationale section, and deploy/teardown instructions, plus a note that build/deploy were not run in-sandbox
verification: Confirm test files and README.md exist and are non-empty
Read the handler test and confirm it imports and calls the real scoring function from lambda source (would fail if that logic were reverted), not just asserting hardcoded values
Confirm README documents the cost rationale and the post-clone `npm install` + `npx cdk deploy` steps and the no-network caveat
Document that `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm test` and `npx cdk synth` are the full-verification commands to run in a networked environment
findings: Added test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts (CDK Template assertions: DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST, Lambda arm64 + nodejs runtime, HTTP API ProtocolType HTTP, exactly 3 ApiGatewayV2::Route resources matched by RouteKey, CloudFront PriceClass_100, S3 PublicAccessBlockConfiguration all-true) and test/handler.test.ts (imports the REAL exported pure scoreAnswers/ScoredQuestion from ../lambda/index; covers all-correct, partial, all-wrong, empty, mismatched-length, out-of-range indices, extra answers, empty quiz). No refactor of lambda/index.ts was needed because scoreAnswers was already an exported pure function in FEAT-002. Added README.md (primarily Japanese) with overview, text architecture diagram, an explicit cost-minimization section (利用コスト最低限) tying each service choice to zero-idle cost, prerequisites, deploy/teardown steps, frontend window.API_BASE config instructions, and a clear no-network sandbox caveat. VERIFICATION DEFERRED: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode means npm registry returns 403 and deps are not installed, so `npm install`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm test`, and `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npx cdk synth` could NOT be executed here and must be run by the operator in a networked environment. Verified by reading: test imports resolve to real exports (scoreAnswers from lambda/index, QuizAppStack from lib/quiz-app-stack) and every assertion matches the actual stack construct properties. REVIEW v1 UPDATES (2026-09-05): (a) Added handler-level security test 'toPublicQuestions (answer stripping)' in test/handler.test.ts that imports the REAL exported toPublicQuestions and asserts answerIndex never appears in the GET /quizzes/{quizId} payload (via hasOwnProperty and a JSON.stringify().not.toContain('answerIndex') deep scan) and that n/text/options are preserved. (b) Updated the stack test route keys to the new '/api'-prefixed RouteKeys and added an assertion that the CloudFront DistributionConfig has a CacheBehavior with PathPattern 'api/*'. (c) Updated README to document the CloudFront '/api/*' same-origin routing (no manual config.js edit needed), the /api-prefixed routes, and the content-type guard in fetchJson. Tests still cannot be executed under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY; run `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci && npm test && npx cdk synth` in a networked environment.
